chapter.title: Additional Regulations and Administration in Residence Districts

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Housing Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Relocated provisions from paragraph (d) of Section 23-154 and Section 23-90, inclusive, and modified to include universal affordability preference provisions and other proposal components
